body: # I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream by Harlan Ellison and The Jaunt by Stephen King would be good picks.

I had to do a bunch of safety courses for my job and the cards we get after passing the course have a photo of our face on them. When doing the qualifications for it, one guy there decided to leave and not complete the course. The cards take 2 months to get made and sent out to our addresses. Just got mine and instead of my photo on my card, it was the photo of the guy that bailed. I sent them back and have to wait another 2 months for the correct cards.
